items.title: Missing helmet
items.trigger: A producer reports a worker without a helmet.
items.input: Timestamp, camera, source event UUID, model version, missing helmet and confidence.
items.workflow: Persist pending observation; operator independently verifies then confirms or dismisses.
items.expected: One attributable review record; no automatic equipment control.
items.exceptions: Occlusion or an uncertain image must be dismissed or held pending.
items.acceptance: Authenticated event appears on the next successful UI refresh; review reason and time persist.

items.title: Missing visibility vest
items.trigger: A camera producer reports a missing visibility vest.
items.input: PPE observation with missing_items containing vest.
items.workflow: Review camera context using an independently available evidence source; record decision.
items.expected: Observation retains its model provenance and final review.
items.exceptions: Reflective lighting can produce false positives; confidence is not proof.
items.acceptance: Vest observation is accepted; duplicate delivery does not increase counts.

items.title: Task-specific gloves, boots and goggles
items.trigger: An upstream producer reports task-specific PPE absent.
items.input: One or more supported missing items, plus camera and model identifiers.
items.workflow: Review against the work permit and task requirements before confirming.
items.expected: Decision explains the applicable task requirement.
items.exceptions: Zone/task policy evaluation is not implemented in the current API.
items.acceptance: Multiple items remain attached to one event and one final review.

items.title: Respirator requirement in controlled area
items.trigger: A worker enters a zone where respiratory protection is required.
items.input: Approved zone policy, permit, person track and validated respirator detector.
items.workflow: Associate person with required protection; request human verification and follow local HSE SOP.
items.expected: An advisory reaches the supervisor without altering safety interlocks.
items.exceptions: Vision cannot establish respirator seal, rating or fit.
items.acceptance: Site-approved tests distinguish visible equipment from certified protection checks.

items.title: Compliant person and denominator
items.trigger: A valid observation detects all zone-required equipment.
items.input: Qualified person track, zone rule and known camera coverage.
items.workflow: Track eligible observation windows and compliant outcomes separately.
items.expected: A defensible compliance denominator is available.
items.exceptions: No detections or camera outages must not count as compliant.
items.acceptance: Compliance reports state coverage, exclusions and independently measured error.

items.title: Multiple people and PPE association
items.trigger: Several workers overlap in one frame.
items.input: Bounding boxes, person tracks, equipment assignments and frame timestamps.
items.workflow: Associate equipment per person; debounce stable violations; flag ambiguous assignments.
items.expected: A helmet on one worker never satisfies another worker.
items.exceptions: Crowds, crossing tracks and small distant objects.
items.acceptance: Annotated multi-person test set meets approved association error limits.

items.title: Night, glare and occlusion
items.trigger: Visibility drops or PPE is partially obscured.
items.input: Quality signals, illumination and confidence distributions.
items.workflow: Mark visibility uncertainty and route ambiguous cases for inspection.
items.expected: Operators see unknown coverage rather than an assertion of compliance.
items.exceptions: Glare, rain, smoke, shadows and camera vibration.
items.acceptance: Per-condition validation reports recall and false alarms per hour.

items.title: Human confirmation and dismissal
items.trigger: A pending event is investigated.
items.input: Event UUID, decision and reason.
items.workflow: Submit one authenticated review; persist reason, time and service actor atomically.
items.expected: The event moves to confirmed or dismissed and leaves the pending queue.
items.exceptions: A second reviewer racing to decide receives conflict.
items.acceptance: Exactly one final review wins; attempts to overwrite return 409.

items.title: Historical queue filtering
items.trigger: An operator investigates a particular camera or status.
items.input: Status, exact camera ID, page size and offset.
items.workflow: Query filtered events, newest received first, using bounded pagination.
items.expected: Counts and event list reflect persisted observations.
items.exceptions: New arrivals can move offset pages; use a fixed reporting export for formal audit.
items.acceptance: Filters exclude other cameras; limit and offset are validated.

items.title: Shift handover and escalation
items.trigger: Pending reviews survive a shift change or exceed agreed SLA.
items.input: Assignments, identity, due time and escalation contact policy.
items.workflow: Hand over pending items; notify the next responsible supervisor and record acknowledgment.
items.expected: Open events have a clear owner and escalation history.
items.exceptions: Unavailable contact, repeated alert or failed notification delivery.
items.acceptance: Test routing, acknowledgment, retry and handover without dropping events.

items.title: Duplicate replay after network recovery
items.trigger: An edge producer retries the same event after uncertain delivery.
items.input: Stable source/event ID with identical normalized payload.
items.workflow: Retry intake; database uniqueness returns the existing event.
items.expected: One persisted event regardless of delivery retries.
items.exceptions: Offline spool and retries themselves must be implemented at the edge.
items.acceptance: Concurrent retries create exactly one event; conflicting reuse returns 409.

items.title: Camera offline or frozen frame
items.trigger: Camera heartbeats stop or image timestamps no longer advance.
items.input: Heartbeat, stream timestamp, frame hash and last successful capture.
items.workflow: Mark coverage unavailable; notify operations; recover with a fresh observation window.
items.expected: Outage duration is visible independently of PPE events.
items.exceptions: A static scene is not necessarily a frozen stream; require time/heartbeat evidence.
items.acceptance: Disconnected and frozen camera tests never display healthy coverage.

items.title: Offline spool and replay
items.trigger: Network access fails while observations continue.
items.input: Durable bounded queue, source IDs, capture times and disk watermark.
items.workflow: Persist locally, retry with backoff, and acknowledge only after durable server receipt.
items.expected: Delayed records preserve capture time and retry identity.
items.exceptions: Disk full, power loss, queue overflow and reordered delivery.
items.acceptance: Power-cycle and reconnect tests recover accepted records without silent loss.

items.title: Clock skew and delayed events
items.trigger: A producer clock is ahead or a buffered event is old.
items.input: Timezone-aware capture timestamp.
items.workflow: Reject observations more than five minutes in the future; accept delayed replay.
items.expected: Observed time and received time remain distinct.
items.exceptions: Naive timestamps are rejected; upstream clock monitoring remains required.
items.acceptance: Future/naive timestamps fail validation; valid delayed records are accepted.

items.title: Database outage
items.trigger: The database cannot be reached or schema is absent.
items.input: Database connectivity and schema query.
items.workflow: Readiness returns 503; producer must retain unacknowledged events.
items.expected: Infrastructure can distinguish a living process from ready storage.
items.exceptions: Automated failover, operator paging and spool are not implemented.
items.acceptance: Missing schema returns 503 without leaking database credentials.

items.title: UI disconnect and stale data
items.trigger: A live refresh fails or credentials expire.
items.input: Authenticated polling response and last successful update.
items.workflow: Display stale-data warning; retry transient failures; clear credentials and data on 401/disconnect.
items.expected: Stale data never presents as a fresh update.
items.exceptions: Background tabs may throttle polling; three seconds is not a guaranteed latency SLA.
items.acceptance: Failure banner appears and successful reconnect refreshes persisted state.

items.title: Backup restore and disaster recovery
items.trigger: Primary storage is lost or corrupted.
items.input: Encrypted off-host backup, recovery point and approved RTO/RPO.
items.workflow: Restore in isolation; reconcile event IDs, review records and retained edge spool.
items.expected: Recovered records satisfy approved recovery objectives.
items.exceptions: A Docker volume or successful backup command is not restore evidence.
items.acceptance: A timed restore drill verifies record counts and uniqueness constraints.

items.title: Unauthorized role and invalid payload
items.trigger: A request lacks credentials, uses the wrong role or malformed data.
items.input: Authorization header and validated event/review body.
items.workflow: Reject role violations; reject unsupported fields and invalid values.
items.expected: No unauthorized event access or review change.
items.exceptions: Shared role tokens do not provide individual identity or site scoping.
items.acceptance: Wrong roles return 401; invalid payloads return 422; existing rows remain unchanged.

items.title: Individual identity and site isolation
items.trigger: Several users or sites share one deployment.
items.input: OIDC claims, site grants, role mapping and immutable audit identity.
items.workflow: Enforce site scope on every query and write; apply token expiry and rotation.
items.expected: A reviewer sees only authorized sites and decisions name the individual.
items.exceptions: Current service credentials are global roles and are insufficient for this workflow.
items.acceptance: Cross-site read/write and revoked/expired identity tests are rejected.

items.title: Evidence privacy and retention
items.trigger: Images contain identifiable workers or sensitive plant details.
items.input: Approved retention, consent/legal basis, object storage ACL and deletion policy.
items.workflow: Minimize stored evidence, restrict access, audit retrieval and enforce deletion.
items.expected: Evidence access and retention meet the approved site policy.
items.exceptions: No image/video upload or evidence store exists in this version.
items.acceptance: Retention and denied-access drills verify deletion and access boundaries.

items.title: Predictive maintenance
items.trigger: A compressor or pump develops abnormal vibration.
items.input: Calibrated vibration, temperature, load, operating state and maintenance history.
items.workflow: Validate sensor quality; compute baseline deviation; review maintenance recommendation.
items.expected: A traceable advisory links to an engineer-reviewed maintenance work order.
items.exceptions: Startup transients, sensor drift, load changes and unseen asset types.
items.acceptance: Backtests and field trials measure lead time, precision and avoided false alarms.

items.title: Gas leak advisory
items.trigger: An independent instrument or validated imaging system reports a potential leak.
items.input: Instrument quality, calibration, sensor position and approved alarm rules.
items.workflow: Route an advisory to a trained operator while certified gas alarms operate independently.
items.expected: Operator follows the existing site emergency procedure.
items.exceptions: AI must not replace certified detection or initiate shutdown controls.
items.acceptance: Approved instrument integration and failure tests preserve independent safety operation.

items.title: Corrosion inspection
items.trigger: Inspection imagery suggests coating loss or corrosion.
items.input: Calibrated imagery, asset location, inspection history and qualified labels.
items.workflow: Flag candidate regions; engineer verifies and schedules approved inspection/NDT.
items.expected: An inspection finding includes evidence and engineering sign-off.
items.exceptions: Visible surface changes do not prove remaining wall thickness.
items.acceptance: Compare against approved inspection ground truth across materials and lighting.

items.title: Pipeline pressure/flow anomaly
items.trigger: Pressure and flow deviate from the expected operating envelope.
items.input: Synchronized calibrated sensors, valve states and operating mode.
items.workflow: Check quality, correlate sensor trends and ask operator to verify.
items.expected: Advisory retains contributing signals and approved response procedure.
items.exceptions: Pump changes, maintenance, communications loss and bad sensor readings.
items.acceptance: Mode-aware replay tests discriminate normal transients from known anomalies.

items.title: Grounded procedure assistance
items.trigger: An engineer asks for the applicable inspection or maintenance procedure.
items.input: Approved versioned manuals, access permissions and retrieved passages.
items.workflow: Retrieve authorized sources; answer with citations and revision; abstain without evidence.
items.expected: The operator can inspect the governing document and confirm applicability.
items.exceptions: Outdated manuals, prompt injection, missing source and conflicting instructions.
items.acceptance: Answers cite approved revisions and never invent emergency operating instructions.

items.title: Model rollout and drift
items.trigger: A new detector is proposed or live data shifts.
items.input: Signed model digest, model card, validation dataset and monitored error metrics.
items.workflow: Run shadow comparison, obtain approval, deploy gradually and preserve rollback.
items.expected: Every observation identifies the model used.
items.exceptions: No model loader, shadow deployment or drift measurement currently exists.
items.acceptance: Rollback and cohort tests retain provenance and satisfy approved error limits.
